release_notes: Hotfix for 0.9.8.0: stream names were wiped on every campaign save. The editor's stream-name field collected the name, but the save INSERT never carried the name column, so every save turned it into NULL - found live while testing 0.9.8.0. Everything else from 0.9.8.0 stands: the Keitaro-style stream picker with Add split button, AND/OR stream filter logic, Select-and-Order-Columns for Landings and Offers with report-grade offer stats, full affiliate-network postback URLs, the campaign-groups fix, the column customizer click/DnD fix, and first-click local landing opening (nested ZIP flatten, upload-blocked save).
